## Availability

Eleven papers are held for 2025. **May is absent from the available MIW source set.** The source copies carry a printed serial that runs EM-2501 to EM-2504 and EM-2506 to EM-2512 with nothing at 2505, and May is likewise absent in 2026. That is recorded as source metadata, not as a finding about the examination calendar: MIW holds no official confirmation that no May sitting took place.

## Marks

Every question is recorded at 16 marks under printed instruction 2 ("All questions carry equal marks"). Six answered questions therefore total 96 against a printed **Total Marks - 100**. The discrepancy is printed on the source copy and is reproduced, not corrected.
